audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[] side/rating disagreed with content win[] on every one of 7 rows — full said Vel'Koz L1-3, Skill L4-6/2items; content said Skill L1-3, Vel'Koz L4-6, Sona 2items. Full-layer breakdown fields were generic template prose ('chord the contacts', 'aura economy') with no real ability names.
audit.why: Content's reasoning is grounded in real kit facts (Vel'Koz can't sustain his poke early, his W-Q-E true-damage combo and Deconstruction passive win the mid poke war, Life Form Disintegration Ray threatens a delete at 6, and Sona's multi-target Crescendo out-values his single-target beam once teamfights start) and matches Vel'Koz's actual pattern; full-layer text was templated filler.
audit.corrected: Rewrote all 7 phases[].side/.rating to match content win[] (already correct on disk, no win[] edit needed), rewrote each why with the grounded reasoning, and rewrote breakdown.early/mid/cooldowns/trading/feeding/carry/late, ahead, tradeGood, tradeBad, enemyWin, and loading using real ability names (Tectonic Disruption, Void Rift, Life Form Disintegration Ray, Deconstruction, Aria of Perseverance, Song of Celerity, Crescendo).

audit.why: Level 6 ult-delete threat and first-item poke peak (Ludens/Blackfire) and two-item Sona teamfight swing are now correctly reflected in the rewritten phases and breakdown.carry/late.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no real cooldown number for Tectonic Disruption and never named the follow-up combo (Void Rift) or ult (Life Form Disintegration Ray) by their real names.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now names Tectonic Disruption (Q) as the combo starter with an approximate low-rank downtime, and states Crescendo only interrupts his ult channel if you flank it.

edits.before: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption: matchup-defining — The knockup starts the true-damage rotation — dodge it and the research stalls. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Song of Celerity banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption (Q) starts his knockup combo — punish only while it's down, roughly 8-10s at low ranks. - Save Song of Celerity for his Life Form Disintegration Ray channel. - Crescendo interrupts that ult only if you flank it.

edits.before: Good trade: Q-chord the pair at aura edge, W the trade-back, walk — invisible margins, compounding ledger. Bad trade: Chord-greeding inside a hook champion's range — the squishiest support in the game has no second chances.
edits.after: Good trade: trade back only when his Q or E is on cooldown, keep Aria sustain running, and walk out cleanly every time. Bad trade: standing in the line his Q splits into so his whole W-Q-E combo lands free on you and your ADC.

edits.before: If Vel'Koz’s duo opens the ledger, reset to vision and patience. A second kill retires your engage button — peel only and rebuild through vision control.
edits.after: If Vel'Koz's duo draws first blood, reset to vision and respect his Q-E range. Down two kills, peel with Crescendo only and rebuild through wards.

edits.before: Carry through the dance — one crescendo on three is a won fight; your job is surviving to press it.
edits.after: Carry through his beam — a multi-target Crescendo on three wins the fight outright late.

edits.before: You are the one-button fight: crescendo the formation and let the auras conduct the cleanup.
edits.after: Multi-target Crescendo and your auras out-value Vel'Koz's single-target beam late.

edits.before: Ahead, accelerate: chord Vel'Koz's duo off every contact and crescendo the recovery attempts.
edits.after: Ahead, keep pressuring his duo off cooldown and Crescendo any recovery attempt he makes on you.

edits.after: Vel'Koz wins by landing Tectonic Disruption (Q) into Void Rift (E), then finishing with a channeled Life Form Disintegration Ray.

edits.before: - Sona vs Vel'Koz - Track: Vel'Koz Tectonic Disruption. - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Tectonic Disruption spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.
